title: BPAN — Bintulu Port Autonomous Navigation: value-based DRL on the real approach chart
description: A chart-grounded case study, separate from the Synthetic Port Studies 1-5. An autonomous vessel navigates the North and South Access Channels of Bintulu Port and berths at the Inner Harbours / Southern Jetty, over a waypoint graph placed on the real approach chart (assets/bintulu/bintulu_chart.png) and extended into the harbour berths. Four value-based DRL variants are evaluated under graded sensor noise and communication packet-loss, with genuinely computed safety and precision metrics. Geometry is a faithful approximation of the chart, not a surveyed hydrographic model.

environment.topology: North Access Channel (buoys NO1'-NO9'/N1'-N9') -> Southern Jetty / Container Terminal / Inner Harbour 2; South Access Channel (R2'-R10'/G2'-G10') -> Inner Harbour 1; shared harbour connector

seed_policy: SAME 8 seeds per cell (paired). env_seed = 42 + seed. Agent RNG = mulberry32(seed*1000003 + 12345).

evaluation.note: greedy; within-distribution generalization (fresh draws from the same Bintulu mission distribution, not a held-out split)

cells_breakdown: 4 algorithms x 3 conditions x 8 seeds = 96 cells, 30 eval eps each = 2,880 eval episodes

analysis_plan.omnibus: two-way factorial algorithm(4) x condition(3) + seed, partial eta^2
analysis_plan.robustness: clean vs harsh per algorithm (paired Wilcoxon + Holm, Cohen d_z)
analysis_plan.cte_reporting: CTE on successful episodes (survivorship-aware); success rate reported alongside

scope_notes: Chart-grounded but synthesized dynamics; faithful geometry, not a certified hydrodynamic/RF simulator.
This is a standalone Bintulu case study, distinct from the Synthetic Port Studies 1-5.
Deployed web application (index.html) is unaffected; this adds a separate bintulu.html simulation.
